builds.message:
prompt-enhancer: fix GGUF duplication between loader and downloader paths

The qwen38_9b variant's GGUF was claimed by two different locations:
the download def checks target/source/file (Qwen3_5_9B_Abliterated/
Qwen3_8_27B_Uncensored/<name>) while the loader resolved only the
assets folder root or <assets>/<name>. Any single placement made one
side re-download or fail.

- qwen35_vl: also search assets_dir/gguf_repo_subfolder/<name> (the
  canonical download layout)
- assets: mark the assets-folder copy as an extraRelPaths alternate
  of the GGUF download def
- download: honor extraRelPaths in process_files_def and
  download_def_missing_files before deciding a file is missing
- wgp: pass extraRelPaths through the process_files_def wrapper
qwen21: default to the Comfy-Org W4A8 text encoder, update Noct finetune descriptions

Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/main'

Add Qwen Image 2.1 Pruna v0.2 profiles

Add standard and upsampled six-step Pruna v0.2 profiles for Qwen Image 2.1, with dedicated dynamic-shift scheduler, Deepy recipes, regression tests, and CI coverage.
studio: polish workflow UX and harden media handoff

studio: move job/run history out of the workspaces root (startup regression)

The Deepy WorkspaceStore treats EVERY workspaces/*.json as a workspace
manifest and raises 'Invalid workspace' otherwise - a persisted
studio_jobs.json (V4.4) crashed wgp.py at startup, in Safe Mode too.
Studio history now lives in workspaces/studio/ (not scanned by the root
glob), with a one-time migration of legacy files on create_web_app and a
regression test pinning both the location and the migration.
ci: allow manual dispatch of the Studio test suites
ci: probe push trigger (Actions were disabled repo-side)

studio: v4.5-audit fixes — VRAM release state machine, responsive inspector, unified task registry (1.6.1)

P1 fixes from the 7 Nov audit:
- workflow_compat: model release no longer derives 'a generation ran' from
  terminal node states. node_callback records generation_started the moment
  a generate/edit/inpaint node enters running; by the time the finally block
  runs those nodes are error/cancelled and the old check was always false -
  failed/cancelled runs leaked VRAM. Concurrent-run gate (others_active)
  unchanged and now unit-tested.
- responsive: pane toggles stay visible at <=1024px - the inspector drawer
  opens as a stacked section, library collapses; the inspector was
  unreachable below 1024 before. e2e now checks 1024/768/390 widths.
- unified task registry: GET /api/tasks merges generation jobs (memory +
  persisted studio_jobs.json) with workflow runs (memory + persisted
  studio_runs.json, new run_finished_callback in WorkflowCompat, atomic
  bounded writes). Queue page renders both kinds with kind badges, cancel
  for running workflow runs and 'Open workflow' (graph restored onto the
  canvas). The execution drawer stays jobs-only.

P2 fixes:
- Inspector: selecting a plain node after a model node now clears
  selectedModel/modelDetail and disables Run this model (stale-model
  submission); prompts are only pushed to model nodes; an empty prompt on a
  node restores as empty
- a synchronous session.submit_task failure now persists the failed job to
  the history (was lost on restart)
- Models refresh awaits the real catalog reload (no fixed 1200ms delay)
- Queue 'View N result(s)' deep-links into the Media Center lightbox via a
  staged-name lookup instead of just opening the library
- Generate: ADVANCED ATTACHMENTS section exposes every native WanGP
  attachment key (image_start, image_refs, video_mask, custom_guide, ...)
  with upload-to-key and clear
- thumbnail warm-up thread swallows stubbed/broken imports (clean e2e logs)

Tests: release paths rewritten against the real queued->running->
error/cancelled sequences + concurrent-run gate (5 tests); run-history
persistence (2 tests); e2e registry/inspector/responsive (5 tests); static
binding contract updated for the two scoped action sites. Full suite 24/24
e2e x3, 112 units. Version 1.6.1.

studio: V4.5 tranche 2 — Models page, Generate input media slots, pane drawers (1.6.0)

- MANAGE > Models: dedicated read-only catalog page (search, type filters,
  availability, capabilities, presets, LoRA inventory) with 'Open in
  Generate' deep link; nav-models no longer routes to the workflow view
- Generate: input media slots derived from the model's inputs metadata;
  each slot maps to WanGP's native ATTACHMENT_KEYS (image_guide/
  video_guide/audio_guide), uploads through /api/media/upload and writes
  the returned path into the settings JSON - no invented parameters reach
  the backend; applyInputPath is a pure exported helper (e2e-tested)
- Workflow panes as drawers at 1024-1439px: the canvas becomes a
  two-column grid, the inspector slides over it from the toolbar toggle
  (kept above the drawer so the toggle stays clickable), the library is
  collapsible too; canvas keeps the visual priority per the concept

E2E: 3 new tests (models page honest state + Generate deep link,
attachment-key mapping, slot rendering from faked model detail). Full
suite 19/19 x2; strict units 108 passed.

studio: V4.5 concept parity — IA regroup, Generate/Queue/Image Editor views, health-derived runtime status (1.6.0)

Information architecture per docs/superpowers/specs/WANGP_STUDIO_UI_CONCEPT.md:
- sidebar groups WORKSPACE (Dashboard, Generate, Workflow), LIBRARY (Media
  Center, Image Editor), MANAGE (Models, Queue), SYSTEM (Resource Center,
  Plugins, Settings); the dead History stub and MODEL TYPES shortcuts are
  gone; old hashes (#library, #media, #history) still route
- Generate view: model picker (search + category filters + availability),
  native defaults + presets, prompt/negative prompt, full settings JSON;
  submits through POST /api/jobs -> the single native queue
- Queue view: full Studio job history (the drawer keeps the 20-card window),
  nav badge counts active jobs
- Image Editor view: honest dependency state from /api/environment
  (enabled/disabled/not_installed) with a matching recovery action; the
  editor itself is never duplicated
- runtime status derived from /api/health (sidebar card, topbar pill,
  footer, body.runtime-down), polled every 30s; catalog errors no longer
  masquerade as a down runtime
- design tokens moved to the concept palette; focus-visible outlines;
  execution drawer collapsible (respects prefers-reduced-motion);
  responsive: compact icon sidebar + stacked panels at <=1024px

Layout fix (latent since 1.4.x): grid items of .main-area now carry
min-width:0 — the drawer's flex row of job cards set the intrinsic
min-content (~4900px with 39 jobs) and stretched every sibling, pushing
the Inspector off-screen.

E2E: test_v45_views.py (7 tests: nav groups, health status, generate
empty state, queue rendering, dependency state, drawer toggle, hash
aliases). Version 1.6.0.
